jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

WHO WE ARE

The TRIGO Group provides quality services worldwide in over 28 countries, setting the highest standards for safety and mobility. Since 2013, TRIGO ADR Germany has been supporting the aerospace and rail industries in quality assurance, operating over 20 locations across Germany.

Our goal is to develop sustainable solutions with the highest quality standards, optimize processes, and drive innovation to consistently exceed our customers’ expectations.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Quality Inspector (m/f/d) with a focus on Source Inspection for the aerospace sector. In this role, you will conduct supplier inspections across Europe, focusing on cabin, structural, and mechanical components.

Reference Number: 04-25

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Supplier Inspections (Source Inspection): Perform detailed inspections of aerospace components and materials directly at European suppliers to ensure compliance with technical specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements
- Documentation Review: Check and evaluate supplier documents such as inspection reports, material certificates, and conformity statements according to aerospace standards (e.g., AS9100, EN9100)
- Inspection Methods: Apply visual, dimensional, and functional testing methods using precise measuring instruments (e.g., micrometers, calipers, height gauges). Knowledge of non-destructive testing (NDT) methods (e.g., ultrasonic, eddy current) is a plus
- Supplier Communication & Audits: Collaborate closely with suppliers to ensure quality requirements are met and participate in audits and assessments to verify compliance with internal and international aerospace standards (e.g., EASA, FAA, FAI)
- Reporting & Documentation: Prepare accurate inspection reports, document deviations, corrective actions, and compliance evidence
- Product Lifecycle Support: Assist in evaluating new components regarding technical specifications, inspection requirements, and safety standards during the development phase

REQUIREMENTS

- Degree in a technical or engineering field, ideally with a focus on aerospace or mechanical engineering
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in quality inspection, preferably in aerospace or industrial manufacturing, ideally with a focus on Source Inspection and supplier quality
- Strong knowledge of common quality standards (AS9100, EN9100, ISO 9001)
- Confident handling of measuring and testing equipment (micrometers, calipers, height gauges, etc.)
- Knowledge of aerospace materials, manufacturing processes, and product specifications
- Understanding of European aerospace regulations and certification requirements (e.g., EASA)
- ASQ Certified Quality Inspector or equivalent certification, and/or approval as inspector by an aerospace OEM is desirable
- Basic training in AS/EN 9100 standards and Human Factors is a plus
- Additional qualifications in NDT (e.g., ultrasonic, eddy current) are an advantage
- High willingness to travel across Europe is mandatory
- Fluent German and/or English, both written and spoken; additional European languages (e.g., French, Spanish) are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER:

In addition to a permanent employment contract, we provide attractive benefits, including:

- 30 days of vacation
- Company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits
- Corporate fitness (Wellpass) and JobRad (bike leasing)
- Company health insurance
- Childcare allowance
- Discounts via Corporate Benefits

APPLY NOW! 

Do the described tasks appeal to you? Then we look forward to receiving your detailed CV! Please include the job title, reference number, and your salary expectations in your application.

For any questions, feel free to contact us by phone or email.

jobs.occupation: Assistant / Associate Professor of Chemistry of "Advanced Materials Science" (m/f/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and transdisciplinary cooperation. According to the 2024 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, Constructor University is among the top 25 percent out of more than 1.900 universities worldwide and is ranked as the second most international university in the world. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, 2000 students from 120 nations live and study on our residential campus.
Constructor University invites applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by February 2027:
 

Assistant / Associate Professor of Chemistry in "Advanced Materials Science" (m/f/d)
(full time; 38.5 hrs./week; tenure track)

Your Responsibilities:  

The School of Science is particularly interested in candidates with a strong focus on the synthesis and physicochemical characterization of Advanced Materials. In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged. Ideal candidates combine experimental and computational approaches. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a cutting-edge externally funded research program at the forefront of the field which complements existing research groups in the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in Chemistry and Advanced Materials Science (lectures and laboratory courses) at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. They will be expected to take a pivotal role in the new MSc program “Advanced Materials” with their research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD theses and research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. Several opportunities exist to develop multidisciplinary research projects in collaboration with other research groups or our industrial partners and to leverage existing research facilities like a clean room, an X-ray diffractometer and a compute cluster.

Your Qualifications:  

- PhD degree in the field of Chemistry or Materials Science.
- Strong publication record in relevant international journals
- Documented research activities in the field of Advanced Materials Science
- Experience in the acquisition of Third-Party funding
- Experience in successful teaching in international and diverse environments, with an interest in applying innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Intercultural experience and competence
- Responsible, self-motivated person able to work independently and as a part of a team
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus
- Ideally, the successful candidate should be eligible for an ERC starting grant (assistant level) or an ERC consolidator grant (associate level).

What you can expect at Constructor University: 

Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings.

In the CHE Ranking, the most comprehensive and detailed ranking of the German-speaking higher education landscape, Constructor University has achieved top placements every year since its first participation in 2005.

- The result counts: trust working hours for work-life balance
- Individual on-boarding, career- and development planning
- Company fitness program offers with EGYM Well Pass (former Qualitrain)
- Green campus with recreation areas, take the tour: Our Campus (http://constructor.university/student-life/campus-life/campus/virtual-tour)
- Constructor University has extensive programs on sustainability and environmental sustainability

Constructor University unequivocally guarantees the academic freedom of every member of the faculty, as well as every other member of the Constructor University community. We encourage diversity in the University in ethnic, cultural, social, religious, political, and national backgrounds, as well as in individual lifestyle. Constructor University offers full equality of opportunity to all qualified applicants and is an equal opportunity employer.
 
Your Application:   

For any further information regarding this position, please contact Prof Susanne Illenberger (Dean), via the Deans' office (DeansOffice@constructor.university).

Apply today - it's simple. We look forward to getting to know you.

Please upload your documents in a single PDF document, including a cover letter, a letter of motivation stating your field of expertise, curriculum vitae, teaching portfolio and publication record, summary of research plans and collaborations including anticipated collaborations at CU (maximum two pages), a list of essential (large) equipment needed to conduct your research, copies of certificates and diplomas, certification of English proficiency (optional), and the names and addresses of two referees in our application management system.

The deadline for submission of applications is 31.10.2026.

The position offered is tenure track, with review of performance after a first contract (assistant level) of three and a second contract after another three years. Successful evaluation leads to permanence and typically promotion to associate professor level. At the associate level, the position is immediately permanent.

The review of applications will begin immediately. Please note that only applications submitted through the official application portal will be considered for recognition.

jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:

PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation

You are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.

In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.

Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.

Your Profile

- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning
- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning
- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs
- natural language generation and explainability
- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling
- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.
- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.
- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.
- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.
- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

- Monthly stipend of €1,650
- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

- Expected start date: February, 2026

Application package must include:

- Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Academic transcripts
- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals
- 2 recommendation letters

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

Talent Development & Learning Specialist 

Harris means choice, expertise & relationship. Choice among industry leading software solutions. Expertise from our employees who are industry, regulatory and domain experts. We invite you to join us and be a part of our exciting journey! We are looking for a Talent Development & Learning Specialist to join our HR International team. This will be remote work.  

We are looking for a passionate and creative Talent Development & Learning specialist to join our team. The role will focus on designing and delivering impactful behavioral learning experiences that help employees and leaders build critical capabilities and perform at their best. 

The ideal candidate understands adult learning principles, can translate business needs into engaging learning solutions, and is comfortable creating training content using both traditional as well as modern methodologies.

Learning Effectiveness & ROI 

- Define measures to evaluate learning effectiveness and business impact

- Use insights to continuously improve learning solutions

Workday Learning
